notation: Logical Arabic in the engine notation (engines.chrono_trigger_arabic): a line for each box of the message, {line} where a line of the box must end; the encoder breaks the other lines itself, a box holding four lines. A message that starts with the speaker's name and a colon (الأم: ) has its other lines and boxes indented under the name, as the English does. {Crono}, {Marle}, {Lucca}, {Robo}, {Frog}, {Ayla} and {Magus} write that member's name as the player gave it, in Latin letters; a line counts 55 pixels for it. A message holds Arabic letters, spaces, Western or Arabic-Indic digits and the punctuation . , : ! - … ، ؛ ؟ only. No vowel marks: the font has none.

entries.context: Crono's mother, the morning of the fair: she wakes him (two lines under her name)
His mother: he slept badly for the excitement of the fair; she wants him to behave (a second box, indented)
entries.text:
الأم: كنت متحمسا جدا لمهرجان الألفية حتى إنك لم تنم جيدا، أليس كذلك…؟
أريدك أن تحسن التصرف اليوم!

entries.context: His mother remembers the name of his inventor friend, then reminds him of her invitation ({Lucca} is her name as the player gave it)
entries.text: الأم: صحيح، {Lucca}!{line}لا تنس أنها دعتك لترى اختراعها الجديد!
